shots.inspector_01_connect: Servers screen: rasoi-toolbox-stdio connected over stdio; right: the protocol messages
shots.inspector_02_connection_info: Connection Info: server name, protocol version, capabilities
shots.inspector_03_tools: Tools (15): every tool.json folder, listed by tools/list
shots.inspector_04_check_stock: check_stock run on GSK-SIL-05L: the tool result JSON
shots.inspector_05_pr_form: create_purchase_request filled in: 20,000 x GSK-SIL-05L on PRD-07, confirm=true
shots.inspector_06_elicitation: the server asks Kavita to confirm (elicitation) before anything is saved
shots.inspector_06b_elicitation_ticked: the confirmation form with Confirm ticked
shots.inspector_07_pr_receipt: after Kavita confirms: the PR receipt read back from Bahi
shots.inspector_07b_mrtr_rounds: Protocol panel: the MRTR entry expanded, tools/call -> input_required -> retry -> complete
shots.inspector_08_policy: Resources: rasoi://policy/purchase opened (the purchase policy as a document)
shots.inspector_09_stock_template: Resource template rasoi://stock/{item_code} read for GSK-SIL-05L
shots.inspector_10_prompt: Prompts: raise_a_pr filled in; the messages it returns (text + the policy attached)

doc_id: POL-PUR-001 title: Purchase Policy owner: Purchase department, Rasoi Steel Works version: 4.1 effective: 2026-04-01 audience: all purchase staff
Purchase Policy (POL-PUR-001)
1. Purpose

This policy sets out how Rasoi Steel Works buys materials, components and services, so that every rupee is spent with the right approval, from a qualified supplier, against an open budget.

2. Scope

It applies to every purchase made for the Pune plant (RSW-PUN-01) and the Chakan unit (RSW-CHK-01), through Bahi ERP.

3. Requests before orders

3.1 Every purchase starts with a purchase request (PR) in Bahi, except a direct order under §3.3. 3.2 A purchase request names the item, the quantity, the need-by date, the warehouse and the cost centre that will carry the spend. 3.3 A direct purchase order without a request is allowed only when its gross value, including GST, is ₹50,000 or less. 3.4 A purchase order raised against a request may not exceed the requested quantity.

4. Cost centres and budgets

4.1 Every request and order must be charged to an open cost centre. 4.2 Finance closes cost centres at the end of a production programme. A closed cost centre cannot carry new spend. Bahi saves an order against a closed cost centre as a Draft; a Draft order is never sent to the supplier. 4.3 Before raising an order, check the cost centre's status in Bahi (screen FIN-CC-01) or ask Finance.

5. Approval limits

5.1 Limits apply to the gross value including GST, not the basic value. 5.2 The approval matrix (POL-APR-002) sets each role's limit. An order above the raiser's own limit must be approved by the next person up the line whose limit covers it. 5.3 Nobody may approve an order they raised. 5.4 Approval of a purchase request covers the purchase order raised against it, provided the approver's limit covers the order's gross value.

6. Supplier qualification

6.1 Orders may be placed only with suppliers that are active in the supplier master. 6.2 Parts that come into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks and any other item marked food-contact in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. # Purchase Policy (POL-PUR-001)

## 1. Purpose
This policy sets out how Rasoi Steel Works buys materials, components and services, so that every rupee is spent with the right approval, from a qualified supplier, against an open budget.

## 2. Scope
It applies to every purchase made for the Pune plant (RSW-PUN-01) and the Chakan unit (RSW-CHK-01), through Bahi ERP.

## 3. Requests before orders
3.1 Every purchase starts with a purchase request (PR) in Bahi, except a direct order under §3.3.
3.2 A purchase request names the item, the quantity, the need-by date, the warehouse and the cost centre that will carry the spend.
3.3 A direct purchase order without a request is allowed only when its gross value, including GST, is ₹50,000 or less.
3.4 A purchase order raised against a request may not exceed the requested quantity.

## 4. Cost centres and budgets
4.1 Every request and order must be charged to an **open** cost centre.
4.2 Finance closes cost centres at the end of a production programme. A closed cost centre cannot carry new spend. Bahi saves an order against a closed cost centre as a Draft; a Draft order is never sent to the supplier.
4.3 Before raising an order, check the cost centre's status in Bahi (screen FIN-CC-01) or ask Finance.

## 5. Approval limits
5.1 Limits apply to the **gross value including GST**, not the basic value.
